nodes.text: An entry wants carrying. Silverfall keeps its own rolls, and old *Skarn* — last man out of the deep galleries — should hear this name spoken before he reads it. Would you go up the mountain?
Above the great falls, north and west — you'll hear the city before you see it. Skarn drinks where old soldiers drink. Ask for the man with the bad leg and the good memory.
Entries keep. That is rather the point of them.
